description_en: Retrieves the details of user logs in log management
description_zh: 获取日志管理中用户日志详情
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-data-storage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataStorage

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center for threat analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: This parameter is required in actual API calls. If it is not provided, the service returns a 400 error with the message "The specified Lang can not be empty." Explicitly pass the language code
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。

注意：此参数在实际调用中为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误 “The specified Lang can not be empty.”，请显式传入语言代码
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to read the auto-discovered index configuration of each Logstore. This operation requires accessing Simple Log Service (SLS) for each Logstore. Default value: false. Set this parameter to true only on the storage management page
parameters.help_zh: 是否读取各日志库的自动发现索引配置。该读取需逐个日志库访问 SLS，默认 false；仅存储管理页面传 true
parameters.name: with_auto_key_detect

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

200.description_en: 成功返回当前账号的日志存储信息。可选投递设置不可用时通过 DeliverySettingsError 说明
200.description_zh: 成功返回当前账号的日志存储信息。可选投递设置不可用时通过 DeliverySettingsError 说明

ColdStorageUsedCapacity.description_en: The amount of cold storage used for user logs
ColdStorageUsedCapacity.description_zh: 用户日志使用冷存储的使用量

DataStorageRegionId.description_en: The storage region for user-side logs
DataStorageRegionId.description_zh: 用户侧日志的存储地域

DataStorageRegionPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the storage region can be modified. By default, modification is not allowed. Contact the product manager to reset the region. The region can be reset only once. Valid values:
allow: The storage region can be modified.
deny: The storage region cannot be modified
DataStorageRegionPermission.description_zh:
是否可以修改存储地域。默认不可以，联系产品经理可以进行地域重置并且只能重置一次。取值：
allow：可以修改。
deny：不可以修改

DataStorageTotalCapacity.description_en: The storage capacity purchased in subscription scenarios
DataStorageTotalCapacity.description_zh: 预付费场景下购买的存储用量

DataStorageUsedCapacity.description_en: The storage capacity used in user log management
DataStorageUsedCapacity.description_zh: 用户日志管理中使用的存储量

DataStorageUsedCapacityDetail.description_en: The details of storage usage by log management users
DataStorageUsedCapacityDetail.description_zh: 日志管理用户使用的存储详情

DeliverySettings.description_en: The multi-account delivery settings for the current storage resource. This parameter is returned when the query is successful. If the read operation fails, refer to DeliverySettingsError
DeliverySettings.description_zh: 当前存储资源的多账号投递设置。查询成功时返回；读取失败时参见 DeliverySettingsError

Accounts.description_en: The account directory of the current local account and managed members
Accounts.description_zh: 当前本账号和纳管成员的账号目录

items.description_en: A displayable source account and its authorization information
items.description_zh: 一个可展示的来源账号及其授权信息

AccountId.description_en: The UID of the source cloud account. The value is a decimal string
AccountId.description_zh: 来源云账号 UID，十进制字符串

AccountName.description_en: The display name of the account. If the name is missing, the UID string is returned
AccountName.description_zh: 账号显示名称，缺少名称时返回 UID 字符串

Authorized.description_en: Indicates whether the account has the authorization required for log delivery. This parameter must be set to true when you add a member
Authorized.description_zh: 该账号当前是否具备日志投递所需授权。新增选择成员时要求为 true

DaAccount.description_en: Indicates whether the account is the current management and delivery target account, which is the local account
DaAccount.description_zh: 是否为当前管理及投递目标账号，即本账号

CanConfigure.description_en: Indicates whether the current account meets the conditions for configuring delivery settings. This is determined based on authorization, target project availability, capacity orders, and the current account identity. The PrerequisiteEnabled parameter must also be set to true
CanConfigure.description_zh: 当前账号是否满足投递设置操作条件，综合授权、目标 Project 可用性、容量订单和当前账号身份判断；仍需同时满足 PrerequisiteEnabled

ConfigurationVersion.description_en: The version of the current delivery settings. When you modify multi-account configurations or specify member delivery, pass this value back as the ConfigurationVersion parameter. Query this value again after each modification. Do not use a fixed sample value
ConfigurationVersion.description_zh: 当前投递设置版本。修改多账号配置或指定成员投递时，作为 ConfigurationVersion 原样传回；每次修改后重新查询，不能固定使用示例值

DaAccountId.description_en: The UID of the current management and delivery target account. The value is a decimal string. This account is also the fixed local account in the account selection list
DaAccountId.description_zh: 当前管理及投递目标账号 UID，十进制字符串；也是账号选择列表中固定保留的本账号

Enabled.description_en: The master switch for saved multi-account centralized delivery. A value of true indicates that the switch is turned on. A value of false indicates that the switch is turned off
Enabled.description_zh: 已保存的多账号集中投递总开关。true 表示开启，false 表示关闭

Initialized.description_en: Indicates whether the initialization of the account scope and automatic inclusion settings upon the first enabling is complete
Initialized.description_zh: 是否已完成首次开启时的账号范围和自动纳入设置初始化

PrerequisiteEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether the prerequisite of enabling multi-account security management in Security Center is met
PrerequisiteEnabled.description_zh: 是否已开启云安全中心多账号安全管理这一使用前提

TargetProject.description_en: The name of the current Simple Log Service project for centralized delivery. When you modify multi-account settings or specify member delivery, pass this value back as the TargetProject request parameter
TargetProject.description_zh: 当前集中投递目标 SLS Project 名称。修改多账号设置或指定成员投递时，应作为 TargetProject 请求参数原样传回

TargetRegion.description_en: The region ID of the current Simple Log Service project for centralized delivery
TargetRegion.description_zh: 当前集中投递目标 Project 所在地域 ID

Types.description_en: The account selection, automatic inclusion settings, and existing delivery status categorized by log type
Types.description_zh: 按日志类型划分的账号选择、自动纳入设置及已有投递状态

items.description_en: The multi-account delivery settings for a log type
items.description_zh: 一个日志类型的多账号投递设置

AutoIncludeNewAccounts.description_en: Indicates whether to automatically add subsequent new and available managed members to the selection scope of this log type
AutoIncludeNewAccounts.description_zh: 是否将后续新增且可用的纳管成员自动加入该日志类型的选择范围

Executions.description_en: The list of statuses for existing source delivery records of this log type
Executions.description_zh: 该日志类型已有来源投递记录的状态列表

items.description_en: The recorded delivery status of a source account
items.description_zh: 一个来源账号已记录的投递状态

AccountId.description_en: The UID of the source account for this delivery record. The value is a decimal string
AccountId.description_zh: 该投递记录的来源账号 UID，十进制字符串

ErrorCode.description_en: A reserved compatibility field. The current implementation does not populate historical execution error codes. This field is usually empty or not returned. If execution fails, read the error code returned by the corresponding write operation
ErrorCode.description_zh: 保留的兼容字段，当前实现不填充历史执行错误码，通常为空或不返回。执行失败请读取对应写接口返回的错误码

Status.description_en:
The recorded delivery status. Valid values:
RUNNING: The delivery is recorded as enabled after the last successful operation.
STOPPED: The delivery is recorded as disabled.
This field does not indicate real-time log arrival
Status.description_zh: 已记录的投递状态：RUNNING 表示上次操作成功后记录为开启，STOPPED 表示记录为关闭。此字段不表示实时日志到达情况

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the delivery status was last updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If the record has no update time, this field is empty or not returned
UpdateTime.description_zh: 投递状态最近更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳；记录无更新时间时为空或不返回

LogCode.description_en: The unique identifier of the log type. This corresponds to UpdateDataStorageDelivery.LogCode
LogCode.description_zh: 日志类型唯一标识，对应 UpdateDataStorageDelivery.LogCode

SelectedAccountIds.description_en: The array of UIDs of the source accounts selected for this log type, including the local account. The response is a JSON string array. When you write an array(simple) request, serialize the value as comma-separated values
SelectedAccountIds.description_zh: 该日志类型已选择的来源账号 UID 数组，包含本账号。响应为 JSON 字符串数组；写入 array(simple) 请求时需序列化为逗号分隔值

items.description_en: The UID of a selected cloud account. The value is a decimal string
items.description_zh: 一个已选择的云账号 UID，十进制字符串

UnavailableReason.description_en:
The reason code for why the configuration is unavailable. Valid values:
DA_UNAUTHORIZED: The management account is not authorized.
TARGET_PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE: The target project is unavailable.
LOG_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE: No valid capacity order exists.
NOT_CURRENT_ACCOUNT: The operation is not performed by the current account.
If the conditions are met, this parameter is empty or not returned
UnavailableReason.description_zh: 不可配置的原因码：DA_UNAUTHORIZED（管理账号未授权）、TARGET_PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE（目标 Project 不可用）、LOG_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE（无有效容量订单）、NOT_CURRENT_ACCOUNT（非当前账号操作）。满足条件时为空或不返回

DeliverySettingsError.description_en: The read fault code for optional multi-account delivery settings. If the read failed, DELIVERY_SETTINGS_UNAVAILABLE is returned. If the read is successful, this field is empty or not returned and does not affect other storage fields
DeliverySettingsError.description_zh: 可选多账号投递设置的读取错误码。读取失败时返回 DELIVERY_SETTINGS_UNAVAILABLE；成功时为空或不返回，不影响其他存储字段
DeliverySettingsError.title_zh: 多账号投递设置读取失败原因

LogProject.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project that stores user logs
LogProject.description_zh: 用户日志对应存储的 SLS Project 名称

LogProjectState.description_en: The status of the log project

LogProjectStateChangeAllowed.description_en: Indicates whether the status of the log project can be changed
LogProjectStateChangeAllowed.description_zh: 是否允许变更日志项目状态

LogServiceDisabled.description_en: Indicates whether the log service is disabled

NormalizationLogStores.description_en: The Logstore details for normalized data
NormalizationLogStores.description_zh: 标准化数据的日志库详情

items.description_en: The Logstore details for normalized data
items.description_zh: 标准化数据的日志库详情

AutoKeyDetect.description_en: Indicates whether automatic index discovery is enabled for the full-text index of the Logstore in Simple Log Service. This field is returned only when WithAutoKeyDetect=true is specified in the request, and is not returned if the read operation fails
AutoKeyDetect.description_zh: 该日志库的 SLS 全文索引是否开启自动发现索引；仅当请求 WithAutoKeyDetect=true 时返回，读取失败时不返回

LogStoreExisted.description_en: Indicates whether the corresponding Logstore in Simple Log Service exists. A value of true indicates that the Logstore exists. A value of false indicates that the Logstore is not created and delivery is not enabled. In this case, automatic index discovery cannot be configured. This field is returned only when WithAutoKeyDetect=true is specified in the request
LogStoreExisted.description_zh: 对应 SLS 日志库是否已存在。true 表示存在，false 表示尚未创建（未开启投递）， 此时无法配置自动发现索引；仅当请求 WithAutoKeyDetect=true 时返回

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore that stores normalized data
LogStoreName.description_zh: 存储标准化数据的日志库名字

LogStoreTtl.description_en: The storage duration for normalized data
LogStoreTtl.description_zh: 存储标准化数据的存储时长

UsedCapacity.description_en: The used capacity of hot storage

ActivityName.description_en: The log type of the normalized log
ActivityName.description_zh: 标准化日志的日志类型

CategoryName.description_en: The category of the normalized log

DetectionRuleReferenceCount.description_en: The number of times the normalized dataset is referenced in the threat analysis integration center
DetectionRuleReferenceCount.description_zh: 该标准化数据集在威胁分析接入中心被引用的次数

DetectionRuleReferenceProductIds.description_en: The list of products that reference the normalized dataset in the threat analysis integration center
DetectionRuleReferenceProductIds.description_zh: 该标准化数据集在威胁分析接入中心被引用的产品列表

items.description_en: The product ID in the threat analysis integration center
items.description_zh: 威胁分析接入中心的产品ID

LogSearchConditions.description_en: The query statement used to query log types in the normalized dataset
LogSearchConditions.description_zh: 标准化数据集中查询日志类型的查询语句
LogSearchConditions.title_zh: JSON 编码的日志查询条件

LogStoreName.description_en: The Logstore in threat analysis that stores normalized logs
LogStoreName.description_zh: 威胁分析存储标准化日志的日志库

LogViewExisted.description_en:
Indicates whether the normalized dataset exists. Valid values:
true: The dataset exists.
false: The dataset does not exist
LogViewExisted.description_zh:
标准化数据集是否存在。取值：
true：存在。
false：不存在

LogViewName.description_en: The name of the normalized dataset

UsedCapacity.description_en: The used capacity of the Logstore

SasLogStores.description_en: The storage details of raw logs from Security Center
SasLogStores.description_zh: 云安全中心原始日志存储详情

items.description_en: The storage details of raw logs from Security Center
items.description_zh: 云安全中心原始日志存储详情

AccountDeliveries.description_en: The delivery records of the log type expanded by source account, including the current account and member accounts with existing records
AccountDeliveries.description_zh: 按来源账号展开的该日志类型投递记录，含本账号及已有记录的成员账号

items.description_en: The delivery record of a single source account
items.description_zh: 单个来源账号的投递记录

AccountId.description_en: The UID of the source Alibaba Cloud account for the logs. This field is an int64 number
AccountId.description_zh: 日志来源云账号 UID，此字段为 int64 数字

AccountName.description_en: The display name of the source account. If the name is unavailable, the account UID string is used
AccountName.description_zh: 来源账号显示名称，未取得名称时使用账号 UID 字符串

IsDaAccount.description_en: Indicates whether the account is the current management or target account. A value of true indicates the current account, and a value of false indicates a member source account
IsDaAccount.description_zh: 是否为当前管理或目标账号（本账号）。true 表示本账号，false 表示成员来源账号
IsDaAccount.title_zh: 是否为委派管理员（DA）或主账号

LogDeliveryStatus.description_en: The recorded delivery status for the source account. Valid values: enable (enabled) and disable (disabled)
LogDeliveryStatus.description_zh: 该来源账号已记录的投递状态：enable（开启）、disable（关闭）

LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_en: The last update time of the delivery status for the source account. This field is empty or not returned if no records are generated
LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_zh: 该来源投递状态的最近更新时间；未产生记录时为空或不返回
LogDeliveryUpdateTime.title_zh: 投递状态最近更新时间

AccountDeliveries.title_zh: 多账号 SAS 日志投递明细

AutoKeyDetect.description_en: Indicates whether automatic index discovery is enabled for the full-text index of the Logstore in Simple Log Service. This field is returned only when WithAutoKeyDetect=true is specified in the request, and is not returned if the read operation fails
AutoKeyDetect.description_zh: 该日志库的 SLS 全文索引是否开启自动发现索引；仅当请求 WithAutoKeyDetect=true 时返回，读取失败时不返回

LogDeliveryGroup.description_en:
The group to which the log belongs. Valid values:
host: Host logs.
security: Security logs
LogDeliveryGroup.description_zh:
日志所在的分组。取值：
host：主机日志。
security：安全日志

LogDeliveryPermission.description_en:
Specifies whether you are allowed to toggle the log delivery switch. Log delivery is unavailable if the service is not purchased. Valid values:
allow: Allowed.
deny: Not allowed
LogDeliveryPermission.description_zh:
是否允许操作日志投递开关，未购买的情况下无法进行投递。取值：
allow：允许。
deny：不允许

LogDeliveryStatus.description_en:
The log delivery status. Valid values:
enable: Delivery is enabled for the log.
disable: Delivery is disabled for the log
LogDeliveryStatus.description_zh:
日志投递情况。取值：
enable：开通该日志的投递。
disable：取消该日志的投递

LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_en: The time of the last log delivery operation. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss
LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次操作日志投递的时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

LogSearchConditions.description_en: The default query conditions for the log. When multiple logs are stored in a single Logstore, you must use query conditions to perform a log query
LogSearchConditions.description_zh: 日志默认查询条件，多个日志存储在一个日志库的时候需要通过查询条件进行单日志查询
LogSearchConditions.title_zh: JSON 编码的日志查询条件

LogStoreExisted.description_en:
Indicates whether the Logstore where the log is stored exists. Valid values:
true: Exists.
false: Does not exist
LogStoreExisted.description_zh:
日志所在的日志库是否创存在。取值：
true：存在。
false：不存在

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore where the log is stored
LogStoreName.description_zh: 日志所在日志库的名字

LogStoreTtl.description_en: The storage duration of the Logstore where the log is stored. The minimum storage duration is 30 days
LogStoreTtl.description_zh: 该日志所在日志库的存储时长，至少存储30天

UsedCapacity.description_en: The used capacity of hot storage

UnusedLogStores.description_en: The list of legacy SIEM V1 Logstores
UnusedLogStores.description_zh: siem V1老版本日志库列表

items.description_en: The information about a legacy SIEM V1 Logstore
items.description_zh: siem V1老版本日志库信息

UsedCapacity.description_en: The used capacity of hot storage

items.title_zh: siem V1老版本日志库信息

UnusedLogStores.title_zh: siem V1老版本日志库列表
